archetypes.name: Forensic Physician
archetypes.replaces: Inspiration; Trapfinding; Trap Sense; 3rd, 5th-level Investigator Talent
archetypes.aonSummary: A forensic physician specializes in analyzing medical details in order to solve crimes and uncover evidence.

archetypes.name: Gravedigger
archetypes.replaces: Weapon and Armor Proficiency; Alchemy; Trapfinding; Trap Sense; Poison Resistance; Poison Immunity; Studied Combat; Studied Strike; Swift Alchemy
archetypes.aonSummary: Gravediggers pursue long buried mysteries, figuratively and literally digging up the truth and finding answers to secrets only moldering corpses and dry bones can tell.

archetypes.name: Guardian of Immortality
archetypes.replaces: Poison Lore; Poison Resistance; 7th, 13th-level Investigator Talent; Poison Immunity
archetypes.aonSummary: Guardians of immortality are Thuvian investigators charged with hunting down those who would attempt to steal or learn for themselves the secret to creating the sun orchid elixir.

archetypes.name: Hallucinist
archetypes.replaces: Trapfinding; Trap Sense; 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, 11th, 15th-level Investigator Talent; Poison Lore' Poison Resistance; Poison Immunity; Keen Recollection; Studied Combat
archetypes.aonSummary: A hallucinist imbibes magical drugs to expand his mind into the psychedelic world, extending his awareness to things he could not normally perceive.

archetypes.name: Holomog Demolitionist
archetypes.replaces: Poison Lore; Poison Resistance; 3rd, 9th-level Investigator Talent; Studied Target
archetypes.aonSummary: Holomog is an ancient nation built on even more ancient ruins. Its renowned civil engineers develop skills that allow them to take full advantage of their environments.

archetypes.name: Infiltrator
archetypes.replaces: Trapfinding; Poison Lore; Poison Resistance
archetypes.aonSummary: An infiltrator specializes in investigating or disrupting groups from within.

archetypes.name: Jinyiwei
archetypes.replaces: Inspiration; Alchemy; Trapfinding; Trap Sense; Swift Alchemy
archetypes.aonSummary: Jinyiwei are a special task force of secret police whose mission is to root out, expose, and counteract their government’s existing wrongdoing.

archetypes.name: Lamplighter
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Poison Lore; Poison Resistance; Poison Immunity; Keen Recollection; Trap Sense
archetypes.aonSummary: Lamplighters are investigators tasked with keeping the night streets safe and lit, and securing darkened areas against whatever dangers lurk in the shadows.

archetypes.name: Lepidstadt Inspector
archetypes.replaces: Trapfinding; Trap Sense; Poison Resistance; Poison Immunity; Swift Alchemy; 5th-level Investigator Talent
archetypes.aonSummary: The ability of investigators trained at the University of Lepidstadt to get to the bottom of a mystery is legendary, and troubled settlements throughout the region often send petitions to the university requesting the aid of a formally trained inspector when some mystery threatens the community as a whole.

archetypes.name: Majordomo
archetypes.replaces: Trapfinding; Alchemy; Swift Alchemy; Trap Sense
archetypes.aonSummary: In a world of intrigue where the loyalties of staff can be bought and sold, sometimes it takes the skills of an investigator to follow the byzantine paper trails and prevent embezzling and espionage within the estates of the elite.

archetypes.name: Malice Binder
archetypes.replaces: Inspiration; Trapfinding; Trap Sense; Alchemy; Poison Resistance; Poison Immunity
archetypes.aonSummary: A lock of hair, a bit of blood, even a footprint is enough to grant a wily witch hunter an edge. Malice binders often rise from the ranks of the common folk rather than from wealthy nobles or the church. Their magic is old and crude, but devastatingly effective against those they hunt.

archetypes.name: Mastermind
archetypes.replaces: Inspiration; Trapfinding; Trap Sense; Swift Alchemy; 9th-level Investigator Talent
archetypes.aonSummary: Although some investigators use their honed senses and cunning insight for personal gain, no one excels at such endeavors like the mastermind.

archetypes.name: Natural Philosopher
archetypes.replaces: Weapon/Armor Proficiencies; Class Skills; Inspiration; Trapfinding; Alchemy; Trap Sense; 3rd-level Investigator Talent
archetypes.aonSummary: Natural philosophers are scholars, explorers, and survivalists who feel at home in nature, seldom longing for the comforts of the city.

archetypes.name: Portal Seeker
archetypes.replaces: Trapfinding; Poison Resistance; Poison Lore; Studied Strike; Poison Immunity
archetypes.aonSummary: While most investigators seek answers to mundane mysteries, portal seekers chase more unusual enigmas: portals to other planes.

archetypes.name: Profiler
archetypes.replaces: Trapfinding; Poison Lore; Trap Sense; Poison Resistance; Poison Immunity; Swift Alchemy; 7th-level Investigator Talent
archetypes.aonSummary: Profilers understand the human psyche to an intense degree, allowing them to predict the criminals they hunt.

archetypes.name: Psychic Detective
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Alchemy; Poison Lore; Poison Resistance; Swift Alchemy; Poison Immunity; 3rd-level Talent; Investigator Talents
archetypes.aonSummary: A psychic detective supplements her keen insight with occult skill to unravel mysteries both ordinary and supernatural.

archetypes.name: Questioner
archetypes.replaces: Inspiration; Alchemy; Poison Lore
archetypes.aonSummary: Dabblers in arcane magic and masters of stealth and guile, questioners are investigators who often find themselves mucking about in cases for less-than-savory clientele or that require an extra bit of subtlety.

archetypes.name: Reckless Epicurean
archetypes.replaces: Trapfinding; 5th, 13th-level Investigator Talent
archetypes.aonSummary: Whether an obsessive scientist, a healer determined to ensure the safety of her tinctures, or a seeker of new and interesting potions, a reckless epicurean’s body is saturated with experimental chemicals and magic.

archetypes.name: Ruthless Agent
archetypes.replaces: Alignment; Inspiration; Trapfinding; Trap Sense; Swift Alchemy; 11th, 17th-level Investigator Talents.
archetypes.aonSummary: Ruthless agents are often called upon for their skills at extracting information by any means necessary.

archetypes.name: Scavenger
archetypes.replaces: Alchemy; Inspiration; Poison Lore; Poison Resistance; Poison Immunity
archetypes.aonSummary: Scavengers are masters of systems: how they fit together, why they work, and how to make the most of their parts.

archetypes.name: Skeptic
archetypes.replaces: Trapfinding; Poison Resistance; Swift Alchemy; 7th level Investigator Talent
archetypes.aonSummary: The skeptic accepts the existence of the occult world while challenging claims that the supernatural explains all of life’s problems.

archetypes.name: Sleuth
archetypes.replaces: Alchemy; Swift Alchemy
archetypes.aonSummary: A sleuth is an investigator who relies on good fortune and guile rather than alchemy.

archetypes.name: Spiritualist
archetypes.replaces: Alchemy; Poison Lore; Poison Resistance; Trap Sense; Swift Alchemy; Poison Immunity
archetypes.aonSummary: While most investigators look to the physical world to gain their knowledge, there are those who seek out knowledge beyond the pale.

archetypes.name: Star Watcher
archetypes.replaces: Weapon/Armor Proficiencies; Alchemy; Trapfinding; Trap Sense; Swift Alchemy
archetypes.aonSummary: Star watchers study the movements and positions of the sun, the moon, and the stars, searching for secrets written in the sky.

archetypes.name: Steel Hound
archetypes.replaces: Weapon/Armor Proficiencies; Poison Lore; Swift Alchemy
archetypes.aonSummary: Steel hounds are investigators who have taken to using firearms in place of the more mundane weapons their counterparts favor.

archetypes.name: Tekritanin Arbiter
archetypes.replaces: Trapfinding; Poison Lore; Poison Resistance; Trap Sense
archetypes.aonSummary: The Tekritanin League facilitated trade and settled disputes between a vast array of diverse cultures. The arbiters were the first line of diplomatic defense, solving problems before they could become disruptive.

archetypes.name: Toxin Codexer
archetypes.replaces: Alchemy; Trapfinding; 3rd-level Investigator Talent; Keen Recollection; Trap Sense
archetypes.aonSummary: A toxin codexer meticulously seeks out new poisons and catalogs their effects, both those that are harmful and those that are potentially beneficial.

archetypes.name: Aquakinetcist
archetypes.replaces: Elemental Focus; Expanded Element; Basic Hydrokinesis; 2nd, 6th-levle Utility Wild Talent; Elemental Defense
archetypes.aonSummary: While all hydrokineticists have the ability to control water, aquakineticists’ powers are tied to their determination to explore the world beneath the waves.

archetypes.name: Arakineticist
archetypes.replaces: 4th, 6th, 8th, and 13th-level Utility Wild Talents
archetypes.aonSummary: Those of strong will who live under a dark curse long enough might learn to control and channel the corrupt energy afflicting them.

archetypes.name: Blightburner
archetypes.replaces: Elemental Focus; Basic Geokinesis; 2nd-level Utility Power; Elemental Overflow; Flesh of Stone; Gather Power; Internal Buffer
archetypes.aonSummary: Darklands geokineticists sometimes exhibit supernatural powers associated with blightburn crystals. Blightburner kineticists harness this radioactivity in pyrotechnic displays, an unusual feat for those connected to the element of earth.

archetypes.name: Blighted Defiler
archetypes.replaces: Alignment; Gather Power; Key Ability Score; Internal Buffer; Elemental Defense; Omnikinesis
archetypes.aonSummary: A few kineticists have developed the ability to steal the life force from the surrounding land in order to infuse themselves with unnatural strength beyond their bodies’ normal capabilities.

archetypes.name: Blood Kineticist
archetypes.replaces: 1st, 5th, 9th, and 11th-level Infusions; 6th and 8th-level Utility Wild Talent; Expanded Element; Omnikinesis
archetypes.aonSummary: To a blood kineticist, the water in a creature’s blood is just like any other sort, and she uses that knowledge to brutal ends.

archetypes.name: Cinderlands Adept
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Elemental Focus; Expanded Element; Gather Power; 1st-level Infusion; 4th, 8th, 12th-level Utility Wild Talent
archetypes.aonSummary: These kineticists are skilled riders, able to wield both weapons and fire with deadly skill.

archetypes.name: Dark Elementalist
archetypes.replaces: Alignment; Key Ability Score; Burn; Elemental Overflow; Internal Buffer
archetypes.aonSummary: Dark elementalists are loathe to suffer the consequences of channeling their power and study the darkest esoteric energies of the planes to use souls to fuel their occult might.

archetypes.name: Elemental Annihilator
archetypes.replaces: 1st, 3rd, 5th, and 9th-level Infusions; all utility wild talents
archetypes.aonSummary: For some kineticists, nothing in life is as sweet as destruction and pain. Elemental annihilators pursue only uses of their powers that harm others.

archetypes.name: Elemental Ascetic
archetypes.replaces: Kinetic Blast; Elemental Overflow; Wild Talents; Elemental Defense; 5th, 9th, 13th-level Infusions
archetypes.aonSummary: Combining the elemental powers of a kineticist with the rigid physical discipline of a monk, an elemental ascetic channels his powers through his body to enhance himself in combat.

archetypes.name: Elemental Purist
archetypes.replaces: Internal Buffer; Expanded Elements; 11th, 19th-level Infusion; Omnikinesis
archetypes.aonSummary: An elemental purist spurns all elements that are not her own, for utter devotion can allow one to accomplish even seemingly impossible heroics.

archetypes.name: Elysiokineticist
archetypes.replaces: Elemental Focus; Class Skills; Expanded Element; Basic Phytokinesis, 1st-level Infusion; Flesh of Wood
archetypes.aonSummary: Similar to how phytokineticists draw their power from the First World, elysiokineticists trace their abilities to the riotous wilderness of the plane known as Elysium

archetypes.name: Ioun Kineticist
archetypes.replaces: Elemental Focus; Basic Telekinesis; Internal Buffer; Elemental Overflow
archetypes.aonSummary: Some aetherkineticists dedicate themselves to unlocking ioun stones’ cosmic secrets and seemingly limitless potential.

archetypes.name: Kinetic Chirurgeon
archetypes.replaces: Infusions; Metakinesis; Infusion Specialization; Internal Buffer
archetypes.aonSummary: While any hydrokineticist or telekineticist can learn the rudiments of healing, some kineticists are virtuosos of the curative arts.

archetypes.name: Kinetic Knight
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Kinetic Blast; Infusions; Metakinesis; Metakinetic Master; 3rd-level Infusion; Supercharge
archetypes.aonSummary: A kinetic knight dons armor and wields a blade of elemental energy.

archetypes.name: Leshykineticist
archetypes.replaces: Element; Expanded Element; 6th, 10th-level Utility Wild Talents; Maximize Metakinesis; Basic Phytokinesis; Internal Buffer; Omnikinesis
archetypes.aonSummary: (Vine Leshy only) Of all those who pursue the path of a kineticist, only leshykineticists are both made of plant matter and born of nature spirits. These curious creatures wield ancient powers unknown to any other kineticists.

archetypes.name: Overwhelming Soul
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Wild Talents; Burn; Internal Buffer; Elemental Overflow
archetypes.aonSummary: Some kineticists have such a powerful personality that they can seize control of their element with their minds alone, without endangering their bodies.

archetypes.name: Psammokinetic
archetypes.replaces: Alignment; Elemental Focus, Elemental Overflow; Expanded Element
archetypes.aonSummary: Psammokinetics are ascetic kineticists who consider the harsh nature of the burning deserts of Osirion to be a tempering fire that can purify all their imperfections.

archetypes.name: Psychokineticist
archetypes.replaces: Key Ability Score; Burn; Elemental Overflow
archetypes.aonSummary: Psychokineticists channel elemental power through their minds rather than their bodies and while this energy ravages their minds, it unleashes power locked in their ruptured emotions.

archetypes.name: Terrakineticist
archetypes.replaces: Elemental Focus; Kinetic Blast; Elemental Defense; Expanded Element; Omnikinesis
archetypes.aonSummary: Terrakineticists have a stunted ability that allows them to access the Elemental Planes, but they’ve learned how to turn this limited talent into an incredible strength by tapping into the ambient elemental nature of the land surrounding them.

archetypes.name: Armored Battlemage
archetypes.replaces: Spell Combat; Arcane Pool; 3rd, 18th-level Magus Arcana; Improved Spell Combat; Greater Spell Combat
archetypes.aonSummary: Armored battlemages learn to move and cast spells in even the most restrictive armors, and have developed new methods to magically enhance their armor.

archetypes.name: Beastblade
archetypes.replaces: 3rd-level Magus Arcana; Spell Recall; Knowledge Pool; Improved Spell Recall
archetypes.aonSummary: Beastblade magi work in tandem with their familiars, using spell, steel, and claw to clear the battlefield of foes.

archetypes.name: Bladebound
archetypes.replaces: Arcane Pool; 3rd-level Magus Arcana
archetypes.aonSummary: A select group of magi are called to carry a black blade—a sentient weapon of often unknown and possibly unknowable purpose.

archetypes.name: Card Caster
archetypes.replaces: Arcane Pool; Spellstrike; 3rd-level Arcana
archetypes.aonSummary: The card caster is an ancient, martial offshoot of the traditional harrower, learning to not only draw power from the harrow, but also to invest each card with deadly power.

archetypes.name: Deep Marshal
archetypes.replaces: Armor Proficiencies; Medium Armor; Heavy Armor; Spellcasting; Arcane Pool; Spell Combat; Spellstrike; 3rd-level Magus Arcana
archetypes.aonSummary: Largely unseen by visitors, the deep marshals have survived into the modern era as keepers, protectors, and repairers of the myriad of stony passages that travel around, through, and under the Five Kings Mountains.

archetypes.name: Eldritch Archer
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Arcane Pool; Spell Combat; Spellstrike; Counterstrike
archetypes.aonSummary: The eldritch archer rains magical attacks down on her foes from the city walls.

archetypes.name: Eldritch Scion
archetypes.replaces: Spells; Spell Recall; Arcane Pool; Spell Combat; Knowledge Pool; Improved Spell Combat; Greater Spell Combat
archetypes.aonSummary: Unlike typical magi, eldritch scions do not study tomes of magic or spend time learning to combine martial and magical skills. Rather, eldritch scions find that their spells and abilities come to them instinctively.

archetypes.name: Elemental Knight
archetypes.replaces: Spell Recall
archetypes.aonSummary: (Suli Only) Elemental knights are born with elemental energies surging through their blood and discover the secret of reconciling and focusing this primal power into the arcane.

archetypes.name: Esoteric
archetypes.replaces: Weapon/Armor Proficiency; Spellcasting; Arcane Pool; Spellstrike; Spell Recall; Bonus Feats; Medium Armor; Heavy Armor; Improved Spell Recall
archetypes.aonSummary: Esoterics are drawn to the mysticism of the occult and spend their lives delving into forgotten texts and forbidden tomes.

archetypes.name: Fiend Flayer
archetypes.replaces: None
archetypes.aonSummary: (Tiefling Only) Some tiefling magi can tap the dark energy of their fiendish blood to enhance their arcane and combat talents.

archetypes.name: Greensting Slayer
archetypes.replaces: Arcane Pool; Medium Armor; Heavy Armor
archetypes.aonSummary: The blending of martial prowess with elven magic has long been a staple of the Blackash Training Grounds in Erages. More than a few who study at Erages Academy follow this path because of the promises of wealth that the city’s criminal element makes toward practiced brawlers and smugglers.

archetypes.name: Hexbreaker
archetypes.replaces: Spell Recall; Improved Spell Recall
archetypes.aonSummary: Hexbreakers—sometimes called witch-hammers for their proclivity toward warhammers—have borne witness to the damage of unrestrained arcane power and hone their own arcane arts to battle such abuse.

archetypes.name: Hexcrafter
archetypes.replaces: Spell Recall
archetypes.aonSummary: A hexcrafter magus has uncovered the secret of using his arcane pool to recreate witch hexes.

archetypes.name: Iron-Ring Striker
archetypes.replaces: Weapon Proficiency; Arcane Pool; Spellstrike; 5th-level Bonus Feat; Medium Armor; Heavy Armor; Knowledge Pool; Counterstrike
archetypes.aonSummary: Practitioners of this martial art, powered by arcane magic, wear an iron ring on the finger of one hand.

archetypes.name: Jistkan Artificer
archetypes.replaces: Spells; Arcane Pool; Cantrips; 3rd-level Magus Arcana; Spellstrike
archetypes.aonSummary: As part of studying the secret methods the original Jistkan artificers used to build golems, these magi graft construct parts onto their own arms.

archetypes.name: Kapenia Dancer
archetypes.replaces: Weapon/Armor Proficiencies; Diminished Spellcasting
archetypes.aonSummary: The kapenia dancer laces their deadly scarves with powerful magic.

archetypes.name: Kensai
archetypes.replaces: Weapon/Armor Proficiency; Spells; Spell Recall; Knowledge Pool; Medium Armor; 9th-level Arcana; Improved Spell Recall; Heavy Armor; True Magus
archetypes.aonSummary: A kensai spends his life focusing his training and meditation into a rapturous perfection of the use of a single weapon, which is usually but not always a sword, channeling his arcane might through it in a dizzying and deadly dance beyond the abilities of even the greatest of mundane warriors.

archetypes.name: Magic Warrior
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; 3rd-level Magus Arcana; Improved Spell Combat; Greater Spell Combat; Greater Spell Access
archetypes.aonSummary: Trained in a tradition stretching back to Old-Mage Jatembe’s Ten Magic Warriors, magic warriors renounce their identities to master magical might and serve as champions of culture and learning across the Mwangi Expanse and beyond.

archetypes.name: Mindblade
archetypes.replaces: Spellcasting; Arcane Pool; Spell Recall; Knowledge Pool; Improved Spell Recall; Greater Spell Combat; Greater Spell Access; Medium Armor; Improved Spell Combat; Heavy Armor
archetypes.aonSummary: A mindblade blends psychic talent and martial skill to lethal effect. By forming weapons with her mind, she always has the right tool for any situation.

archetypes.name: Myrmidarch
archetypes.replaces: Spells; Spell Recall; Improved Spell Recall; 6th, 12th, 18th-level Magus Arcana; Knowledge Pool; Improved Spell Combat; Greater Spell Combat; True Magus
archetypes.aonSummary: The myrmidarch is a skilled specialist, using magic to supplement and augment his martial mastery.

archetypes.name: Nature-Bonded Magus
archetypes.replaces: Arcane Pool; Spell Recall; Knowledge Pool; Improved Spell Recall
archetypes.aonSummary: A nature-bonded magus synergizes arcane magic and the divine magic traditions of druids into a deadly synthesis.

archetypes.name: Puppetmaster
archetypes.replaces: Skills; Knowledge Pool; Greater Spell Access; Arcane Pool; Spell Combat; Improved Spell Combat; Greater Spell Combat; Spellstrike; Fighter Training; Counterstrike; Medium Armor; Heavy Armor; True Magus
archetypes.aonSummary: Puppetmasters focus on using charm and illusion spells to control the senses of those for whom they perform.

archetypes.name: Sigilus
archetypes.replaces: Spellstrike; Medium Armor; Heavy Armor
archetypes.aonSummary: A sigilus manipulates the discoveries of wizards and other more sagacious Cyphermages, using those findings to create special sigils that allow her to transfer spell effects into different objects for later use.

archetypes.name: Skirnir
archetypes.replaces: Spells; Spell Combat; Spell Recall; Knowledge Pool; Improved Spell Combat; Greater Spell Combat; Greater Spell Access; Counterstrike
archetypes.aonSummary: Sometimes called a shield-vassal or shieldmaiden, the skirnir has learned to infuse his power into his shield.

archetypes.name: Sorrowblade
archetypes.replaces: 3rd, 12th-level Magus Arcana; Speed Weapon Property
archetypes.aonSummary: A magus who has suffered greatly over the course ofher life can learn to channel that misery into her weapon and inflict it on others.

archetypes.name: Soul Forger
archetypes.replaces: Spells; Knowledge Pool; Spell Recall; Improved Spell Recall; Counterstrike; Greater Spell Access
archetypes.aonSummary: The soul forger has learned the skill of infusing the raw magical essence of his soul into armaments of surpassing power, combining the mystic arts with the arts of war in a unity of steely perfection.

archetypes.name: Spell Dancer
archetypes.replaces: Arcane Pool; 5th-level Bonus Feat; Medium Armor; Heavy Armor
archetypes.aonSummary: (Elf Only) Many elven magi do not consider themselves masters of a blend of martial and magical talents, but rather a sub-category of wizards who study the effect of physical movement and techniques upon spellcasting ability.

archetypes.name: Spell Trapper
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Spell Recall; Fighter Training
archetypes.aonSummary: Spell trappers forsake much of their arcane skill and martial knowledge in exchange for the ability to conjure magical traps to hinder their foes.

archetypes.name: Spellblade
archetypes.replaces: Spellstrike
archetypes.aonSummary: A spellblade magus can manifest a ghostly blade of force that can be used as an off-hand weapon.

archetypes.name: Spire Defender
archetypes.replaces: Weapon/Armor Proficiencies; Spell Recall
archetypes.aonSummary: Magi who train themselves to accompany sages and archaeologists venturing into the Mordant Spire become spire defenders.

archetypes.name: Staff Magus
archetypes.replaces: Weapon/Armor Proficiencies; Medium Armor; Heavy Armor; Fighter Training
archetypes.aonSummary: While most magi use a one-handed weapon as their melee implement of choice, one group of magi uses the quarterstaff instead.

archetypes.name: Fiend Keeper
archetypes.replaces: Alignment; Spirit; Haunt Channeler; Location Channel; Connection Channel; Ask the Spirits
archetypes.aonSummary: Fiend keepers serve as a vessel to contain one of the world’s evil spirits so that it cannot inflict further harm.

archetypes.name: Kami Medium
archetypes.replaces: Spirit; Taboo; Spellcasting; Haunt Channeler; Location Channel; Connection Channel; Ask the Spirits; Astral Journey
archetypes.aonSummary: Some mediums channel the power of nature spirits called kami rather than the spirits of legend.

archetypes.name: Medium of the Master
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Armor Proficiency; Spirit; Spirit Surge; Spirit Power (Lesser): Shared Seance; Spirit Power (Intermediate); Trance of Three; Spirit Power (Supreme)
archetypes.aonSummary: A medium of the master forgoes a connection with most spirits to form a bond with the spirits of great martial artists.

archetypes.name: Nexian Channeler
archetypes.replaces: Spirit; Knacks; Taboo; Haunt Channeler; Location Channel; Connection Channel; Propitiation; Ask the Spirits; Astral Journey; Trance of Three; Spacious Soul; Spirit Mastery; Astral Beacon
archetypes.aonSummary: The archmage Nex long ago created an astral reflection of himself from which he can draw additional power. This echo now serves as an appropriate spirit for well-trained mediums to channel.

archetypes.name: Outer Channeler
archetypes.replaces: Spirit; Taboo; Haunt Channeler; Connection Channel; Location Channel; Ask the Spirits; Astral Journey
archetypes.aonSummary: Outer channelers invite extraplanar entities to inhabit them, allowing the likes of angels and demons to use them as vessels in exchange for power.

archetypes.name: Reanimated Medium
archetypes.replaces: Spirit; Taboo; Haunt Channeler; Location Channel; Connection Channel; Spacious Soul; Astral Beacon
archetypes.aonSummary: Sometimes a departed soul destined for legend gains a second chance at life by possessing his own revived body.

archetypes.name: Relic Channeler
archetypes.replaces: Spirit; Haunt Channeler; Location Channel; Connection Channel
archetypes.aonSummary: A relic channeler carries relics of legend around with her.

archetypes.name: Rivethun Spirit Channeler
archetypes.replaces: Spellcasting; Spirit; Spirit Bonus; Spirit Surge; Taboo; Connection Channel
archetypes.aonSummary: Rivethun spirit channelers are mediums who practice the ancient dwarven philosophy of the rivethun, which teaches that power lies in the connection between physical bodies and immaterial souls.

archetypes.name: Spirit Dancer
archetypes.replaces: Spirit; Spirit Bonus; Spirit Surge; Taboo; Shared Seance; Trance of Three; Spacious Soul; Astral Beacon
archetypes.aonSummary: A spirit dancer enacts an exuberant dance to the spirits, accepting many roles in the shifting dance and changing dance partners quickly.

archetypes.name: Spirit Eater
archetypes.replaces: Haunt Channeler; Location Channel; Connection Channel
archetypes.aonSummary: Guardians of their communities, spirit eaters absorb the dead to channel their power and serve as a line of defense against all manner of incorporeal yokai.

archetypes.name: Storm Dreamer
archetypes.replaces: Spirit Surge; Haunt Channeler; Location Channel; Connection Channel
archetypes.aonSummary: Storm dreamers serve the Storm Kindlers by communing with their mystical predecessors. They serve as spiritual advisors for the organization, and are valued for the lore and wisdom they gain during their trances.

archetypes.name: Storyteller
archetypes.replaces: Spirit; Spirit Bonus; Spirit Surge; Shared Seance; Taboo; Haunt Channeler; Propitiation; Trance of Three; Connection Channel; Spirit Mastery; Astral Beacon
archetypes.aonSummary: While all mediums connect to legendary spirits, storyteller mediums take their obsession with legends to the extreme, suffusing their lives with epic tales at the cost of some of their spiritual power.

archetypes.name: Uda Wendo
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Spirit; Shared Seance; Haunt Channeler; Location Channel; Connection Channel
archetypes.aonSummary: Uda wendo are powerful mediums who are sensitive to the presence and desires of the wendo, powerful and mysterious entities that walk Golarion while shaping fate and guiding destiny.

archetypes.name: Vessel of the Failed
archetypes.replaces: Spirit; Spirit Mastery; Spirit Surge; Taboo
archetypes.aonSummary: A vessel of the failed channels the spirits of those who attempted the Test of the Starstone but failed; these spirits grant the medium abilities wrought from the spirits’ ultimate shortcomings.

archetypes.name: Voice of the Void
archetypes.replaces: Spirit; Taboo; Haunt Channeler
archetypes.aonSummary: Some mediums delve deeply into the spirit world and make contact with entities that exist outside the boundaries of the sane multiverse.

archetypes.name: Aromaphile
archetypes.replaces: Hypnotic Stare; Painful Stare; Towering Ego; Bold Stare; Touch Treatment; Mental Potency
archetypes.aonSummary: (Ghoran only) Rather than employ the baleful glares of the typical mesmerist, aromaphiles hypnotize others using an array of sickeningly sweet scents developed from their unique ghoran physiology.

archetypes.name: Autohypnotist
archetypes.replaces: Hypnotic Stare; Mental Potency
archetypes.aonSummary: An autohypnotist has incredibly powerful psychic abilities that he can’t entirely control.

archetypes.name: Chart Caster
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Mesmerist Tricks; Manifold Tricks; Touch Treatment
archetypes.aonSummary: Lirgeni astrologists would divine their futures by consulting star charts, but some had no talent for astrology and simply faked their results. When prophecy died with Aroden, a few Lirgeni survivors continued with this “reliable” method.

archetypes.name: Cult Master
archetypes.replaces: Consummate Liar; Painful Stare; Mesmerist Tricks; 3rd, 6th, and 14th-level Touch Treatments; 7th-level Bold Stare; Masterful Tricks; Rule Minds
archetypes.aonSummary: The leaders of some cults are simply charlatans, bathing in the adulation of their followers. Others believe themselves to be truly in touch with an unknown power, bringing their unique messages to those willing to follow and obey them.

archetypes.name: Dreamstalker
archetypes.replaces: Painful Stare; 1st-level Mesmerist Trick; Towering Ego; Touch Treatment; Manifold Tricks; Glib Lie
archetypes.aonSummary: Many mesmerists concentrate their studies on conscious, rational thought, but dreamstalkers instead delve into the unleashed unconscious mind that wanders free in dreams.

archetypes.name: Enigma
archetypes.replaces: Hypnotic Stare; Consummate Liar; Painful Stare; Touch Treatment; Manifold Tricks; Glib Lie; Rule Minds
archetypes.aonSummary: An enigma spends his life dedicated to developing psychic abilities that allow him to operate unnoticed.

archetypes.name: Eyebiter
archetypes.replaces: Consummate Liar; 1st-level Mesmerist Trick; Touch Treatment; Mental Potency; Glib Lie
archetypes.aonSummary: An eyebiter’s eyes become so infused with psychic might that they can leave the eyebiter’s body and move about on their own.

archetypes.name: Fey Trickster
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Spellcasting; Towering Ego; Touch Treatment; Rule Minds
archetypes.aonSummary: Most mesmerists draw psychic power from the Astral Plane, but a few gain their powers in an unusual way: from a brush with the fey.

archetypes.name: Gaslighter
archetypes.replaces: Alignment; Consummate Liar; Touch Treatment; Painful Stare;
archetypes.aonSummary: A gaslighter takes joy in others’ suffering, delighting in driving them to madness.

archetypes.name: Hate-Monger
archetypes.replaces: Alignment; Consummate Liar; Touch Treatment; Mental Potency; Manifold Tricks; 7th-level Bold Stare; Glib Lie
archetypes.aonSummary: Hate-mongers are xenophobic and judgmental rabblerousers who whip up mobs against enemies real or imagined.

archetypes.name: Material Manipulator
archetypes.replaces: Spellcasting; Consummate Liar; 2nd-level Mesmerist Trick; Manifold Tricks; Touch Treatment; Rules Minds
archetypes.aonSummary: Rather than waste time limiting himself to ruling minds, a material manipulator forces his whims upon reality and uses his magic to ensure that those around him comply with his demands.

archetypes.name: Mindwyrm Mesmer
archetypes.replaces: Consummate Liar; Painful Stare
archetypes.aonSummary: Mindwyrm mesmers emulate the confidence, swagger, and fear inspired by dragons to bully and browbeat others into obedience.

archetypes.name: Projectionist
archetypes.replaces: Spellcasting; 4th-level Mesmerist Trick; Mental Potency
archetypes.aonSummary: Not content to simply command others from afar, a projectionist is able to use his mesmerizing powers to utterly dominate other creatures and objects by projecting his spirit from his body.

archetypes.name: Spirit Walker
archetypes.replaces: Spells; Consummate Liar; Mental Potency; 3rd, 6th, 10th, and 14th-level Touch Treatments; Rule Minds
archetypes.aonSummary: Some mesmerists specialize in dominating and controlling undead rather than the living.

archetypes.name: Thought Eater
archetypes.replaces: Consummate Liar; Towering Ego; Touch Treatment; Rule Minds
archetypes.aonSummary: Mesmerists that learn to pierce deep into the minds of their victims are known as thought eaters, dangerous individuals capable of devouring thoughts and assuming the knowledge those notions represent for themselves.

archetypes.name: Toxitician
archetypes.replaces: Consummate Liar; Hypnotic Stare; Painful Stare; Bold Stare; Touch Treatment; Glib Lie
archetypes.aonSummary: Toxiticians forgo the mesmerist’s stare, instead combining their psychic power with their alchemical knowledge to craft injections that torment their foes and bolster themselves and their allies.

archetypes.name: Umbral Mesmerist
archetypes.replaces: Spellcasting; 1st, 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, and 20th-level Mesmerist Tricks; Towering Ego; Mental Potency
archetypes.aonSummary: Trained in secret, umbral mesmerists are clandestine weapons who spend years learning how to shape terrifying creatures from the inky darkness in which they revel.

archetypes.name: Vexing Daredevil
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; 1st-level Mesmerist Trick; Touch Treatment; Bold Stare; Glib Tongue
archetypes.aonSummary: Vexing daredevils train their psychic powers for combat, specializing in momentarily blinding and confusing their foes with sudden feints and tricks.

archetypes.name: Vexing Trickster
archetypes.replaces: Consumate Liar, Touch Treatment
archetypes.aonSummary: Vexing tricksters indulge in the various hijinks their power enables.

archetypes.name: Vizier
archetypes.replaces: Consummate Liar; 3rd-level Bold Stare; Towering Ego; Mental Potency
archetypes.aonSummary: While many mesmerists focus on beguiling their foes or taking overt control of others with their mental powers, viziers carve out a subtler niche for themselves as advisors.

archetypes.name: Vox
archetypes.replaces: Spellcasting; Towering Ego; 10th-level Mesmerist Trick; Touch Treatment; Hypnotic Stare
archetypes.aonSummary: Most mesmerists practice their mental manipulation through their entrancing gaze, but others have learned to practice their skill through the lilt and intonation of their voice.

archetypes.name: Black Asp
archetypes.replaces: Stunning Fist; Still Mind
archetypes.aonSummary: The black asps are a sinister order of monks who train as assassins and infiltrators with no need for weapons to achieve their goals.

archetypes.name: Brazen Disciple
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; 1st, 6th-level Bonus Feats; Still Mind; Abundant Step; Perfect Self
archetypes.aonSummary: Brazen disciples use deception in their fighting style, and many go a step further, incorporating fire and smoke both mundane and magical.

archetypes.name: Disciple of Wholeness
archetypes.replaces: Ki Pool; Purity of Body; Diamond Body; Diamond Soul
archetypes.aonSummary: Disciples of wholeness train to bring themselves and others closer to physical and spiritual perfection.

archetypes.name: Drunken Master
archetypes.replaces: Still Mind; Purity of Body; Diamond Body; Diamond Soul; Empty Body
archetypes.aonSummary: The drunken master finds perfection through excess.

archetypes.name: Elemental Monk
archetypes.replaces: Alignment; Stunning Fist; Bonus Feats; Evasion; Purity of Body; Diamond Body; Ki Pool
archetypes.aonSummary: Elemental monks draw inspiration from genies to create their fighting style. Their adaptability and versatility make them capable of serving as emissaries of elemental balance.

archetypes.name: Far Strike Monk
archetypes.replaces: Weapon/Armor Proficiencies; Flurry of Blows; Bonus Feats; Stunning Fist; Still Mind; Purity of Body; Diamond Body
archetypes.aonSummary: Far strike monks are masters of thrown weapons, from shuriken to throwing axes to spears.

archetypes.name: Flowing Monk
archetypes.replaces: Stunning Fist; 2nd-level Bonus Feat; Fast Movement; Purity of Body; Diamond Body; Quivering Palm
archetypes.aonSummary: The flowing monk is the wind and the river. He knows how the world flows, and forces his enemies to flow with it.

archetypes.name: Gray Disciple
archetypes.replaces: Slow Fall; Still Mind; High Jump; 6th-level Bonus Feat; Wholeness of Body; Abundant Step; Quivering Palm; Tongue of the Sun and Moon; Empty Body
archetypes.aonSummary: (Duergar Only) The gray disciple contemplates the inner voice of duergar magic and the silent eternity of stone, mastering these dual mysteries and combining them to deadly effect.

archetypes.name: Hamatulatsu Master
archetypes.replaces: Bonus Feats; Stunning Fist; Ki Pool; Purity of Body
archetypes.aonSummary: Once part of the Sisterhood of Eiseth, the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinyes is an order of female monks dedicated to emulating the painful strikes of the barbed devil, leaving targets alive but permanently scarred and broken by pain—a method called hamatulatsu.

archetypes.name: Harrow Warden
archetypes.replaces: Weapon/Armor Proficiencies; Stunning Fist; Improved Evasion; Diamond Body; Quivering Palm
archetypes.aonSummary: Some who study the mysteries of the harrow do so to restore lost knowledge and pride to the Varisian people. The harrow warden fulfills this role as she seeks to bring her mind and body into alignment, and she protects her people by invoking the folklore that has guided them for so long. In mastering her own place in fate, a harrow warden learns how to misalign the destinies of others.

archetypes.name: Hellcat
archetypes.replaces: Alignment; Class Skills; Weapon Proficiencies; Bonus Feats; Stunning Fist; Fast Movement; Evasion; Purity of Body; Improved Evasion; Slow Fall; Still Mind; Ki Pool; Wholeness of Body; Diamond Body
archetypes.aonSummary: Monks of the hellcat sect follow the teachings of Asmodeus or another infernal power.

archetypes.name: Hungry Ghost Monk
archetypes.replaces: Stunning Fist; Purity of Body; Wholeness of Body; Diamond Body; Diamond Soul
archetypes.aonSummary: The hungry ghost monk looks to spirits that prey upon the living as models of perfection.

archetypes.name: Invested Regent
archetypes.replaces: 1st-level Bonus Feat
archetypes.aonSummary: The invested regent can harness a divine spark to perform superhuman stunts, influence others, and escape injury.

archetypes.name: Ironskin Monk
archetypes.replaces: Monk’s AC; Bonus Feats; Evasion; Ki Speed Increase; High Jump; Fast Movement; Slow Fall; Improved Evasion; Tongue of the Sun and Moon; Perfect Self
archetypes.aonSummary: (Hobgoblin Only) Through discipline and training, an ironskin monk hardens his body to withstand punishing blows.

archetypes.name: Karmic Monk
archetypes.replaces: Alignment; Class Skills; Stunning Fist; Still Mind; 7th and 10th-level Ki Pool Abilities; Improved Evasion; Slow Fall; Perfect Self
archetypes.aonSummary: A karmic monk contemplates the myriad harmonies that guide existence. He learns to use the disharmony in others against them, and to alter his own inner harmonies to exploit weaknesses in his opponents’ defenses.

archetypes.name: Kata Master
archetypes.replaces: Stunning Fist; Still Mind; Ki Pool; Wholeness of Body; Quivering Palm
archetypes.aonSummary: The kata master takes the visual aspect of his martial art to its logical extreme, harnessing her flowing movements and skilled maneuvers as a psychological weapon against her enemies.

archetypes.name: Ki Mystic
archetypes.replaces: Still Mind; Purity of Body; Diamond Body; Diamond Soul; Empty Body
archetypes.aonSummary: The ki mystic believes that violence is sometimes necessary, but knowing and understanding is the true root of perfection.

archetypes.name: Lifting Hand
archetypes.replaces: Stunning Fist; Bonus Feats; Abundant Step
archetypes.aonSummary: When facing a master of the lifting hand, an enemy is likely to find itself sailing through the air or locked in a tortuous compliance hold.

archetypes.name: Maneuver Master
archetypes.replaces: Flurry of Blows; Still Mind; Slow Fall; Purity of Body; Diamond Body; Quivering Palm
archetypes.aonSummary: The maneuver master specializes in more complicated moves than simple damage-dealing strikes.

archetypes.name: Martial Artist
archetypes.replaces: Still Mind; Slow Fall; Ki Pool; Purity of Body; Diamond Body; Perfect Self; Wholeness of Body; Timeless Body; Tongue of Sun and Moon; Abundant Step; Diamond Soul; Empty Body
archetypes.aonSummary: The martial artist pursues a mastery of pure martial arts without the monastic traditions. He is a master of form, but lacks the ability to harness his ki.

archetypes.name: Master of Many Styles
archetypes.replaces: Bonus Feats; Flurry of Blows; Perfect Self
archetypes.aonSummary: The master of many styles is a collector. For every move, he seeks a counter. For every style, he has a riposte.

archetypes.name: Menhir Guardian
archetypes.replaces: Alignment; Weapon/Armor Proficiencies; Unarmed Strike; Ki Pool; Flurry of Blows; Stunning Fist; High Jump; Quivering Palm
archetypes.aonSummary: Menhir guardians are ascetic protectors of sacred druidic sites, less concerned with structure and maintaining internal order than they are with preserving the natural balance of the world.

archetypes.name: Monk of the Empty Hand
archetypes.replaces: Monk Weapon Proficiencies; Still Mind; Purity of Body; Diamond Body
archetypes.aonSummary: The monk of the empty hand eschews normal weapons in favor of whatever is lying around—rocks, chair legs, flagons of ale, even a simple quill pen all become deadly weapons in the hands of such a monk.

archetypes.name: Monk of the Four Winds
archetypes.replaces: Stunning Fist; Abundant Step; Timeless Body; Perfect Self
archetypes.aonSummary: The monk of the four winds is connected to the natural world in a way few other creatures—even other monks—can hope to match.

archetypes.name: Monk of the Healing Hand
archetypes.replaces: Wholeness of Body; Diamond Body; Quivering Palm; Perfect Self
archetypes.aonSummary: Monks of the healing hand seek perfection through helping others.

archetypes.name: Monk of the Lotus
archetypes.replaces: Stunning Fist; Abundant Step; Quivering Palm; Tongue of the Sun and the Moon
archetypes.aonSummary: While a monk of the lotus realizes that combat cannot always be avoided—and is more than capable in a fight—he understands that all creatures are connected, and to harm another is to harm the self.

archetypes.name: Monk of the Mantis
archetypes.replaces: 2nd, 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th-level Bonus Feats; Wholeness of Body; Diamond Body; Diamond Soul; Quivering Palm
archetypes.aonSummary: A body contains many points where the flesh, mind, and spirit coincide. A monk of the mantis is skilled at manipulating these points.

archetypes.name: Monk of the Sacred Mountain
archetypes.replaces: Evasion; Slow Fall; High Jump; Improved Evasion; Tongue of the Sun and the Moon
archetypes.aonSummary: The monk of the sacred mountain finds strength and power in the earth beneath his feet.

archetypes.name: Monk of the Seven Forms
archetypes.replaces: Bonus Feats; Stunning Fist; Maneuver Training; Abundant Step; Quivering Palm
archetypes.aonSummary: In their place, the monks of the isolated sanctuary now teach a style featuring lightning-fast strikes that mimic both dervish dances and the searing winds of the arid desert, favoring mobility and endurance.

archetypes.name: Nimble Guardian
archetypes.replaces: Evasion; Still Mind; Purity of Body; Wholeness of Body; Improved Evasion
archetypes.aonSummary: (Catfolk Only) Some catfolk monks dedicate their graceful prowess to the defense of others, especially those dedicated to a similar ethos or who prove themselves as stalwart allies of the monk’s cause.

archetypes.name: Nornkith
archetypes.replaces: Key Ability Score; Stunning Fist; 1st-, 10th-level Bonus Feat; Purity of Body; Diamond Soul; Quivering Palm; Empty Body; Perfect Self
archetypes.aonSummary: Nornkith hone their bodies and minds to follow the branching threefold paths of fate.

archetypes.name: Ouat
archetypes.replaces: Greed, Hatred, Defensive Training, Stonecunning, Weapon Familiarity (Dwarven Racial Traits); Stunning Fist; Wholeness of Body
archetypes.aonSummary: (Dwarf Only) The ascetic, desert-dwelling dwarves known as the Ouat have eschewed dwarven traditions, whose unchanging rigidity, they believe, shackles their people to the past and inhibits self-improvement.

archetypes.name: Perfect Scholar
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Still Mind; Slow Fall; Tongue of the Sun and Moon; Perfect Self
archetypes.aonSummary: Perfect scholars, often worshipers of Irori, hone their minds and bodies through the accumulation of knowledge

archetypes.name: Qinggong Monk
archetypes.replaces: Slow Fall; High Jump; Wholeness of Body; Diamond Body; Abundant Step; Diamond Soul; Quivering Palm; Timeless Body; Tongue of the Sun and Moon; Empty Body; Perfect Self
archetypes.aonSummary: The qinggong monk is a master of her ki, using it to perform superhuman stunts or even blast opponents with supernatural energy.

archetypes.name: Sage Counselor
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; 1st, 2nd, 6th, 10th-level Bonus Feat; Ki Pool abilities
archetypes.aonSummary: Sage counselors are ascetics and mystics who leave the confines of the monastery walls to advise secular people about spiritual truths and to seek knowledge of the outside world.

archetypes.name: Scaled Fist
archetypes.replaces: Bonus Feats; Still Mind; Maneuver Training; Quivering Palm
archetypes.aonSummary:
Scaled fists eschew passive introspection in favor of unshakable confidence.
Steeped in traditions that trace their origins to the warrior-monks who trained under the tutelage of draconic masters in Tian Xia, scaled fists eschew passive introspection in favor of unshakable confidence. Scaled fists learn to combine brutal intimidation with the brazen ferocity of an ancient wyrm to devastate their foes.

archetypes.name: Scarred Monk
archetypes.replaces: Ki Pool; High Jump; Wholeness of Body; Abundant Step, Empty Body
archetypes.aonSummary: For monks who seek the truth hidden in pain, the practice of mortifications of the flesh helps to achieve enlightenment and acquire disturbing powers.

archetypes.name: Sensei
archetypes.replaces: Flurry of Blows; Fast Movement; Improved Evasion; Evasion; 2nd, 6th, 12th, 18th-level Bonus Feats
archetypes.aonSummary: The sensei is a revered teacher who imparts lessons on the oneness of mind, body, and spirit, along with occasional correction that is subtle and swift.

archetypes.name: Serpent-Fire Adept
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Stunning Fist; 1st, 2nd, 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th-level Bonus Feats; Slow Fall; High Jump; Wholeness of Body
archetypes.aonSummary: A serpent-fire adept embraces the secrets of her chakras and mastery of their energetic flow.

archetypes.name: Sin Monk
archetypes.replaces: Ki Pool; High Jump; Wholeness of Body; Abundant Step; Empty Body; Perfect Self
archetypes.aonSummary: (Ex-monk archetype) Martial experts who have allowed such passions to lead them astray may find themselves gaining powers drawn from their newly embraced sins.

archetypes.name: Softstrike Monk
archetypes.replaces: Weapon Proficiency; Unarmed Strike; 6th, 10th-level Bonus Feats; Wholeness of Body; Quivering Palm; Empty Body
archetypes.aonSummary: Softstrike monks employ a nonlethal but effective form of combat.

archetypes.name: Sohei
archetypes.replaces: Weapon/Armor Proficiency; Stunning Fist; Fast Movement; Increased Unarmed Damage; Slow Fall; Abundant Step; Purity of Body; Diamond Body; Quivering Palm; Timeless Body; Tongue of Sun and Moon
archetypes.aonSummary: The sohei are masters of the horse and the hunt.

archetypes.name: Soul Shepherd
archetypes.replaces: Stunning Fist; Evasion; Improved Evasion; Abundant Step; Quivering Palm
archetypes.aonSummary: Whether studying at the feet of psychopomps or merely imitating the creatures' philosophy and methods, soul shepherds believe in safeguarding the Cycle of Souls.

archetypes.name: Spirit Master
archetypes.replaces: Still Mind; Maneuver Training; Purity of Body; Wholeness of Body; Quivering Palm; Empty Body; Perfect Self
archetypes.aonSummary: Spirit masters are monks who specialize in combating the undead, laying their corpses to rest, and sending their souls to final judgment.

archetypes.name: Student of Stone
archetypes.replaces: Evasion; Fast Movement; Bonus Feat; High Jump; Improved Evasion; Abundant Step
archetypes.aonSummary: (Oread Only) By following the path of the stone, students of stone give up much of monks’ mobility in favor of sheer resilience.

archetypes.name: Terra-Cotta Monk
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Evasion; High Jump; Improved Evasion; Abundant Step; Quivering Palm; Empty Body
archetypes.aonSummary: Possessing a natural affinity for all things earthen, terracotta monks are experts at turning the stone around them against their enemies.

archetypes.name: Tetori
archetypes.replaces: Bonus Feats; Flurry of Blows; Slow Fall; High Jump; Abundant Step; Improved Evasion; Timeless Body; Tongue of Sun and Moon; Diamond Soul; Empty Body
archetypes.aonSummary: The style of the tetori is that of the majestic wrestler—a warrior with a dizzying array of grabs, holds, and locks with which to bewilder and incapacitate his foes.

archetypes.name: Treetop Monk
archetypes.replaces: Still Mind; Purity of Body; Abundant Step
archetypes.aonSummary: (Vanara Only) While many vanaras follow traditional monastic training and traditions, others learn to blend exotic combat and the mysterious forces of ki with the natural world, allowing them to move through trees and overgrowth to deliver devastating attacks.

archetypes.name: Underfoot Adept
archetypes.replaces: 1st-level Bonus Feat; Stunning Fist; High Jump
archetypes.aonSummary: (Halfling Only) An underfoot adept turns his diminutive stature and unorthodox footwork into a powerful weapon.

archetypes.name: Wanderer
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; 1st-level Bonus Feat; Still Mind; Slow Fall; High Jump; Wholeness of Body; Abundant Step; Diamond Soul
archetypes.aonSummary: (Human Only) Some monks wander the world in humility to learn and to share wisdom and philosophy from their teachers with those they meet, often aiding those who are in need.

archetypes.name: Wasteland Meditant
archetypes.replaces: Stunning Fist; Evasion; Slow Fall; Improved Evasion; Quivering Palm
archetypes.aonSummary: Some monks journey to remote and isolated corners of the world to find serenity and a heightened sense of awareness.

archetypes.name: Water Dancer
archetypes.replaces: Flurry of Blows; Stunning Fist; Quivering Palm; 1st, 2nd, 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th-level Bonus Feats; Unarmed Strike; Evasion; Slow Fall; Improved Evasion; Abundant Step
archetypes.aonSummary: Water dancers derive their martial training from ancient nereid traditions jealously guarded by these enigmatic fey.

archetypes.name: Weapon Adept
archetypes.replaces: Stunning Fist; Evasion; Improved Evasion; Timeless Body; Perfect Self
archetypes.aonSummary: While all monks train in both unarmed combat and with weapons, the weapon adept seeks to become one with his weapons, transforming them into perfect extensions of his own body.

archetypes.name: Wildcat
archetypes.replaces: Still Mind; Ki Pool; High Jump; Slow Fall; Improved Evasion; Abundant Step; Diamond Soul; Empty Body
archetypes.aonSummary: A wildcat is a student of the school of hard knocks, who dedicates himself to learning how to take down foes by any means necessary.

archetypes.name: Windstep Master
archetypes.replaces: Stunning Fist; Slow Fall; Ki Pool
archetypes.aonSummary: Most monks are agile and fleet of foot, but few can rival a windstep master’s lightness of step.

archetypes.name: Zen Archer
archetypes.replaces: Stunning Fist; Evasion; Maneuver Training; Still Mind; Purity of Body; Improved Evasion; Diamond Body; Tongue of the Sun and the Moon
archetypes.aonSummary: The zen archer takes a weapon most other monks eschew and seeks perfection in the pull of a taut bowstring, the flex of a bow’s limbs, and the flight of an arrow fired true.

archetypes.name: Black Asp
archetypes.replaces: Stunning Fist; Still Mind
archetypes.aonSummary: The black asps are a sinister order of monks who train as assassins and infiltrators with no need for weapons to achieve their goals.

archetypes.name: Brazen Disciple
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; 1st, 6th-level Bonus Feats; Still Mind; 12th-level Ki Power; Perfect Self
archetypes.aonSummary: Brazen disciples use deception in their fighting style, and many go a step further, incorporating fire and smoke both mundane and magical.

archetypes.name: Disciple of Wholeness
archetypes.replaces: Ki Pool; Purity of Body; 4th, 12th, 14th level Ki Power
archetypes.aonSummary: Disciples of wholeness train to bring themselves and others closer to physical and spiritual perfection.

archetypes.name: Elemental Monk
archetypes.replaces: Alignment; Stunning Fist; Bonus Feats; Evasion; Purity of Body; 10th-level Ki Power; Ki Pool
archetypes.aonSummary: Elemental monks draw inspiration from genies to create their fighting style. Their adaptability and versatility make them capable of serving as emissaries of elemental balance.

archetypes.name: Invested Regent
archetypes.replaces: 1st-level Bonus Feat
archetypes.aonSummary: The invested regent can harness a divine spark to perform superhuman stunts, influence others, and escape injury.

archetypes.name: Lifting Hand
archetypes.replaces: Stunning Fist; Bonus Feats; 12th-level Ki Power
archetypes.aonSummary: When facing a master of the lifting hand, an enemy is likely to find itself sailing through the air or locked in a tortuous compliance hold.

archetypes.name: Monk of the Mantis
archetypes.replaces: 2nd, 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th-level Bonus Feats; 6th, 10th, 12th-level Ki Powers; Quivering Palm
archetypes.aonSummary: A body contains many points where the flesh, mind, and spirit coincide. A monk of the mantis is skilled at manipulating these points.

archetypes.name: Perfect Scholar
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Still Mind; 4th-level Ki Power; Tongue of the Sun and Moon; Perfect Self
archetypes.aonSummary: Perfect scholars, often worshipers of Irori, hone their minds and bodies through the accumulation of knowledge

archetypes.name: Sage Counselor
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; 1st, 2nd, 6th, 10th-level Bonus Feat; 4th-level Ki Power
archetypes.aonSummary: Sage counselors are ascetics and mystics who leave the confines of the monastery walls to advise secular people about spiritual truths and to seek knowledge of the outside world.

archetypes.name: Scaled Fist
archetypes.replaces: Bonus Feats; Still Mind; 4th, 12th-level Ki Power
archetypes.aonSummary:
Scaled fists eschew passive introspection in favor of unshakable confidence.
Steeped in traditions that trace their origins to the warrior-monks who trained under the tutelage of draconic masters in Tian Xia, scaled fists eschew passive introspection in favor of unshakable confidence. Scaled fists learn to combine brutal intimidation with the brazen ferocity of an ancient wyrm to devastate their foes.

archetypes.name: Serpent-Fire Adept
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Stunning Fist; 1st, 2nd, 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th-level Bonus Feats; 4th, 8th-level Ki Power
archetypes.aonSummary: A serpent-fire adept embraces the secrets of her chakras and mastery of their energetic flow.

archetypes.name: Softstrike Monk
archetypes.replaces: Weapon Proficiency; Unarmed Strike; 6th, 10th-level Bonus Feats; Wholeness of Body; Quivering Palm; Empty Body
archetypes.aonSummary: Softstrike monks employ a nonlethal but effective form of combat.

archetypes.name: Soul Shepherd
archetypes.replaces: Stunning Fist; Evasion; Improved Evasion; 12th, 16th-level Bonus Feat
archetypes.aonSummary: Whether studying at the feet of psychopomps or merely imitating the creatures' philosophy and methods, soul shepherds believe in safeguarding the Cycle of Souls.

archetypes.name: Windstep Master
archetypes.replaces: Stunning Fist; 4th-level Ki Power; Ki Pool
archetypes.aonSummary: Most monks are agile and fleet of foot, but few can rival a windstep master’s lightness of step.

archetypes.name: Frozen Shadow
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Ki Pool; Uncanny Dodge; Improved Uncanny Dodge
archetypes.aonSummary: Frozen shadows belong to a rare ninja clan operating in Avistan and they work as thieves, power brokers, and spies loosely guided by secretive masters with unknown agendas.

archetypes.name: Gunpowder Bombardier
archetypes.replaces: Ki Pool; 2nd-level Ninja Trick; Uncanny Dodge; Improved Uncanny Dodge
archetypes.aonSummary: Ratfolk assassins and other ninjas with an affinity for gunpowder demonstrate masterful control of bombs, using the explosives to inflict major damage or impair their foes

archetypes.name: Hunting Serpent
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; No Trace; Uncanny Dodge; Improved Uncanny Dodge; 10th, 12th, 16th-level Ninja Trick
archetypes.aonSummary: Hunting serpents are specially trained killers to that hunt relentlessly and fight from the shadows.

archetypes.name: Mask of the Living God
archetypes.replaces: Weapon and Armor Proficiency; Poison Use; Ki Pool; No Trace
archetypes.aonSummary: When the Living God needs to silence the voices of those heretics who question too loudly, these enforcers are the tools he employs.

archetypes.name: Petal Ninja
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; 2nd-level Ninja Trick; No Trace; Uncanny Dodge; Improved Uncanny Dodge; Light Steps
archetypes.aonSummary:
(Ghoran Only) Petal ninjas are a secretive clan of ghoran infiltrators, in touch with their plantlike nature to the point where they can change their forms, allowing them access into places that were previously impossible to reach.
Petal ninja is an archetype available only to ghorans.

archetypes.name: Ancestral Aspirant
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Implements; Object Reading; Outside Contact
archetypes.aonSummary: It is common for a noble to possess a deep pride for his family’s past, but when such self-importance gives way to obsession, an ancestral aspirant is born.

archetypes.name: Battle Host
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Weapon/Armor Proficiency; Implements; Mental Focus; Spellcasting; Implement Mastery; Magic Item Skill; Object Reading; Shift Focus; Magic Circles; Binding Circles; Fast Circles; Aura Sight; Outside Contact
archetypes.aonSummary: Well versed in military history, battlefield lore, and the occult, a battle host forms a supernatural bond with a chosen weapon, suit of armor, or shield, from which he can channel psychic energy to cast spells, conjure the spirit of the object’s former owner, increase his own physical might, and produce a number of other remarkable abilities.

archetypes.name: Construct Collector
archetypes.replaces: 3rd, 9th, 15th-level Focus Power; Magic Circles; Outside Contact; Binding Circles; Fast Circles
archetypes.aonSummary: Construct collectors draw out a construct's spiritual presence and use it to gain unlikely power in the battlefield.

archetypes.name: Curator
archetypes.replaces: Implements; 3rd-level Focus Power; Shift Focus; Outsider Contact; Magic Circles; Binding Circles; Fast Circles
archetypes.aonSummary: Most occultists acquire and study antiques at a steady pace, learning new techniques one at a time. A lucky few join wealthy organizations replete with relics or inherit undocumented vaults full of historical treasures, and dabble in a wide variety of implements while mastering few

archetypes.name: Esoteric Initiate
archetypes.replaces: Mental Focus; Implements; Shift Focus; Aura Sight
archetypes.aonSummary: While most occultists learn to draw power from a variety of implements and objects, esoteric initiates have focused their study entirely on items of antiquity connected to the teachings of the Esoteric Order of the Palatine Eye, believing such items to be more powerful than mundane items.

archetypes.name: Extemporaneous Channeler
archetypes.replaces: Weapon Proficiencies; Mental Focus; Shift Focus; Magic Circles; Outside Contact; Binding Circles; Fast Circles
archetypes.aonSummary: Extemporaneous channelers study the power of transformation and use items in unintended ways to awaken their potential.

archetypes.name: Geomancer
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Mental Focus; Implements; Magic Item Skill; Aura Sight; 7th and 13th-level Focus Powers
archetypes.aonSummary: A geomancer studies every type of land, deriving power from the differences between types of terrain.

archetypes.name: Haunt Collector
archetypes.replaces: Implements; Aura Sight; Outside Contact; Magic Circles; Binding Circles; Fast Circles
archetypes.aonSummary: Haunt collectors use items haunted by their former owners to create ghostly presences imbued with psychic power.

archetypes.name: Naturalist
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Mental Focus; Magic Circles; Fast Circles; Outside Contact; Binding Circles
archetypes.aonSummary: A naturalist eschews the contact with outsiders that other occultists use as the core of their work. Instead, he attunes his mind to the natural spirits that exist everywhere, just out of sight for the unawakened mind.

archetypes.name: Necroccultist
archetypes.replaces: Implements; Implement Mastery; Object Reading; Aura Sight; Outside Contact
archetypes.aonSummary: Necroccultists’ fascination with death and the undead drives them to explore the forbidden necromantic arts as they search for secrets they can use to manipulate the natural cycle of life and death.

archetypes.name: Occult Historian
archetypes.replaces: Object Reading; Aura Sight; 3rd-level Focus Power; Outside Contact 2, 3, and 4
archetypes.aonSummary: Many wilderness areas contain the remnants of ancient civilizations, with some waiting to be discovered and some held by fierce monsters or devious cults. An occult historian seeks these ruins not only for their esoteric artifacts but also to learn the structures’ secrets.

archetypes.name: Panoply Savant
archetypes.replaces: Shift Focus; Outside Contact; Magic Circles; Binding Circles; Fast Circles
archetypes.aonSummary: Some occultists specialize in a particular panoply, fully dedicating themselves to mastering the secrets of the psychic resonance of each of its component implements, as well as the way they interact with one another.

archetypes.name: Planar Harmonizer
archetypes.replaces: Implements; Implement Mastery; Magic Item Skill; Shift Focus; 5th, 7th-level Focus Power; Magic Circles; Aura Sight
archetypes.aonSummary: Planar harmonizers are masters of the planar symphony, forging bonds with tuning forks to unlock the true potential of these instruments

archetypes.name: Psychodermist
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Implements; Magic Item Skill; Object Reading; Aura Sight; Outside Contact; Binding Circles; Fast Circles
archetypes.aonSummary: Rather than tapping the psychic energy residing within esoteric items, psychodermists form supernatural bonds with trophies taken from creatures they have slain. Through these mementos, these occultists manifest not only their own magic, but also the unique powers of their fallen foes.

archetypes.name: Reliquarian
archetypes.replaces: Weapon Proficiencies; Spells; Focus Powers; Implements; Knacks; Mental Focus
archetypes.aonSummary: Not all occultists derive their power from psychic impressions left on objects. Some find faith first, and draw out the divine potential in religious relics.

archetypes.name: Secret Broker
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Implements; Implement Mastery; Magic Item Skill; Shift Focus; Magic Circles; Binding Circles; Fast Circles
archetypes.aonSummary: Whether as spymasters, extortionists, political fixers, or puppet masters, secret brokers use their talents with objects to gain information, then leverage that information for their own purposes.

archetypes.name: Sha'ir
archetypes.replaces: Implements; Mental Focus; Spellcasting; Implement Mastery; Magic Item Skill; Object Reading; Aura Sight; Outside Contact
archetypes.aonSummary: Sha’irs delve into the occult not through power over objects but instead via their connection with minor servitor genies from the elemental planes.

archetypes.name: Silksworn
archetypes.replaces: Spellcasting; Class Skills; Knacks; Implements; Weapon and Armor Proficiency; Outside Contact; Magic Circles; Binding Circles; Fast Circles; Implement Mastery
archetypes.aonSummary: Silksworn draw their power from wearing luxurious garments and can be found in many noble courts throughout Golarion

archetypes.name: Talisman Crafter
archetypes.replaces: Implements; Magic Item Skill; Object Reading; Shift Focus; Aura Sight; 5th, 17th-level Focus Powers
archetypes.aonSummary: Talisman crafters specialize- in the creation of seals, constructing master talismans to use as implements and inscribing wards with esoteric geometry.

archetypes.name: Tome Eater
archetypes.replaces: Implements; Mental Focus; Spellcasting; Implement Mastery; Shift Focus; 6th-level Implement; Magic Circles; Outside Contact; Binding Circles; Fast Circles; Aura Sight
archetypes.aonSummary: Tome eaters have learned how to tap into the latent psychic energy of the written word by physically devouring books and scrolls to create magical effects and gain mystical insights.

archetypes.name: Ancient Lorekeeper
archetypes.replaces: Mystery Bonus Skills; 4th, 6th, 8th, 10th, 12th, 14th, 16th, and 18th-level Bonus Spells
archetypes.aonSummary: (Elf Only) The ancient lorekeeper is a repository for all the beliefs and vast knowledge of an elven people.

archetypes.name: Black-Blooded Oracle
archetypes.replaces: Oracle’s Curse
archetypes.aonSummary: The black-blooded oracle has been infused with the eerie influence of strange fluids that seep from the rock in the deepest pits of the Darklands, the so-called Black Blood of Orv.

archetypes.name: Community Guardian
archetypes.replaces: Mystery Class Skills; 2nd, 4th, 6th, 10th, 12th level Mystery Bonus Spells; 1st, 3rd-level Revelations
archetypes.aonSummary: (Halfling Only) The community guardian is chosen to protect and succor the weak and innocent within her community.

archetypes.name: Cyclopean Seer
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Curse; Bonus Spells; 1st and 7th-level Revelations; Final Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: A cyclopean seer draws power from the mysterious prophetic abilities of ancient giants.

archetypes.name: Divine Numerologist
archetypes.replaces: 10th, 12th, 14th, 16th, 18th-level Mystery Bonus Spells; 1st, 7th-level Revelation; Final Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: Divine numerologists use esoteric mathematics and numbers traditions to peer into the past and future and extract meaningful portents.

archetypes.name: Dual-Cursed Oracle
archetypes.replaces: Oracle’s Curse; Mystery Class Skills; Mystery Bonus Spells
archetypes.aonSummary: All oracles are cursed to some degree, but some oracles bear an even heavier burden.

archetypes.name: Elementalist Oracle
archetypes.replaces: 4th, 6th, 8th, 10th ,12th, 18th-level Mystery Bonus Spells; 1st, 11th-level Revelation; Final Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: An elementalist oracle has an affinity with the elements and elemental creatures. She can communicate with elemental creatures, and can eventually become an elemental herself.

archetypes.name: Enlightened Philosopher
archetypes.replaces: Mystery Class Skills; Mystery Bonus Spells; 7th-level Revelation; Final Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: The enlightened philosopher seeks enlightenment through compassion, moderation, and humility.

archetypes.name: Hermit
archetypes.replaces: Mystery; Curse; 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th-level Bonus Spells; 1st, 7th-level Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: A hermit is a recluse who gained her oracular powers from isolation in a deep desert, on a mountain peak, or in another secluded location.

archetypes.name: Inerrant Voice
archetypes.replaces: 2nd, 4th, 8th, 14th-level Bonus Spells; 3rd-level Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: An inerrant voice serves as a spiritual advisor to either a monarch or noble.

archetypes.name: Keleshite Prophet
archetypes.replaces: Mystery Skills; 6th, 10th, 12th, 16th, 18th-level Bonus Spells; 1st-level Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: Keleshite prophets help guide and serve the vast Padishah Empire of Kelesh and its interests across Golarion.

archetypes.name: Ocean's Echo
archetypes.replaces: Mystery Bonus Skills; 4th, 8th, 10th, 12th, 14th-level Bonus Spells; 1st, 3rd, 15th-level Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: Although many merfolk claim deep connections to both art and the natural world, a rare few merfolk can manipulate the forces of nature and weave them into song.

archetypes.name: Pei Zin Practitioner
archetypes.replaces: Mystery Class Skills; 1st-, 7th-level Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: In distant Tian Xia, herbalists practice an obscure alchemical art known as Pei Zin herbalism, which involves medicinal and restorative techniques that are used throughout much of that continent.

archetypes.name: Planar Oracle
archetypes.replaces: Mystery Bonus Spells; 3rd-level Revelation; Final Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: A planar oracle has an affinity with one of the Outer Planes.

archetypes.name: Possessed Oracle
archetypes.replaces: Oracle’s Curse; Mystery Bonus Spells; 1st-level Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: Some oracles are possessed by spirits, demons, or similar beings.

archetypes.name: Psychic Searcher
archetypes.replaces: Bonus Spells; 2nd-level Mystery Spell; 3rd-level Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: A psychic searcher is devoted to revealing the hidden within the world around her by sensing and communing with residual mental energy, haunts, and fragments of living spirits that can dwell in objects or rooms.

archetypes.name: Purifier
archetypes.replaces: Bonus Spells; Spellcasting; 3rd, 7th, 11th-level Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: (Aasimar Only) The purifier seeks out signs of possession or mind control that manifest from unwilling (and often unwitting) servants for fiendish corruptors and their mortal minions.

archetypes.name: Reincarnated Oracle
archetypes.replaces: Oracle’s Curse; Bonus Spells; 1st, 3rd, or 7th-level Revelations (must pick two)
archetypes.aonSummary: (Samsaran Only) A reincarnated oracle draws her knowledge and power from the experiences of her previous lives.

archetypes.name: River Soul
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; 2nd, 6th, 8th, 10th ,18th-level Mystery Bonus Spells; Oracle's Curse; 1st, 11th-level Revelation; Final Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: River soul oracles derive their powers from their bonds with rivers, whether these waterways are rapid cascades or lazy channels plied by boats.

archetypes.name: Seeker
archetypes.replaces: Mystery Class Skills, 3rd-level Revelation, 15th-level Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: The seeker is obsessed with learning about their heritage and history, researching ancient texts and obscure ruins for clues.

archetypes.name: Seer
archetypes.replaces: Mystery Bonus Spells; 1st-level Revelation; 3rd-level Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: While all oracles possess some ability at divination, the seer is a true prophet, able to see things as they really are, or will be.

archetypes.name: Shigenjo
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Bonus Spells; 7th-level Revelation; Final Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: (Tengu Only) The shigenjo walks the path of enlightenment and transcendence by seeking oneness with the celestial spirits.

archetypes.name: Spirit Guide
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; 3rd, 7th, and 15th-level Revelations
archetypes.aonSummary: Through her exploration of the universe’s mysteries, a spirit guide opens connections to the spirit world and forms bonds with the entities that inhabit it.

archetypes.name: Stargazer
archetypes.replaces: Mystery Bonus Spells; 1st-level Revelation; 7th-level Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: Some oracles seek meaning in the pattern of the stars across the night sky, the trails of comets, and the eternal orbits of the planets.

archetypes.name: Tree Soul
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Weapon and Armor Proficiency; 2nd, 10th, 12th, 14th, 16th, 18th-level Mystery Bonus Spells; Oracle's Curse; 1st, 11th-level Revelation; Final Revelation
archetypes.aonSummary: Tree souls develop an affinity not just with trees but also with objects carved from them, feeling the essence of the tree’s spirit living within.

archetypes.name: Warsighted
archetypes.replaces: 1st, 7th, 11th, and 15th-level Revelations
archetypes.aonSummary: A warsighted’s unique gifts are not in strange magical revelations, but in her ability to adapt in the midst of a battle with new fighting techniques.

archetypes.name: Banishing Warden
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; 3rd-level Mercy
archetypes.aonSummary: The banishing warden is an expert at fighting all types of evil outsiders and sending them back to their native planes.

archetypes.name: Champion of the Cascade
archetypes.replaces: Armor Proficiency; Class Skills; Divine Health; Mercy; Divine Bond
archetypes.aonSummary: Champions of the cascade are paladins who defend the freedom and purity of waterways, protecting the very existence of the civilizations they belong to.

archetypes.name: Chaos Knight
archetypes.replaces: Lay on Hands; Mercy; Aura of Faith
archetypes.aonSummary: (Ganzi only) Despite the entropic forces inherent in ganzis, some forgo a life of chaos, instead harnessing their heritage to enforce the power of law

archetypes.name: Chosen One
archetypes.replaces: Divine Bond; Class Skills; Divine Grace; Smite Evil; Lay on Hands; Channel Positive Energy
archetypes.aonSummary: Most paladins train for years at a temple to attain a holy status, but rarely, an emissary of the divine appears to one of humble origins and calls her directly to the charge.

archetypes.name: Combat Healer Squire
archetypes.replaces: Detect Evil; Divine Grace; Divine Health
archetypes.aonSummary: The combat healer squire is always ready with bandages and potions.

archetypes.name: Divine Defender
archetypes.replaces: Mercy; Divine Bond
archetypes.aonSummary: Some paladins see themselves as the last line of defense between the teeming hordes of evil and the innocent folk trying to make a living in a harsh, unforgiving world.

archetypes.name: Divine Guardian
archetypes.replaces: Spellcasting; Detect Evil; Lay on Hands; Aura of Courage
archetypes.aonSummary: The divine guardian devotes herself to the protection and guardianship of one creature at a time, be that her liege lord, an allied cleric, or an innocent facing overwhelming danger at the hands of evil.

archetypes.name: Divine Hunter
archetypes.replaces: Heavy Armor Proficiency; Aura of Courage; Divine Bond; 6th-level Mercy; Aura of Resolve; Aura of Justice; Aura of Righteousness
archetypes.aonSummary: The divine hunter prefers to engage evil from afar, striking down her foes before they can threaten her allies.

archetypes.name: Dusk Knight
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Smite Evil; Channel Positive Energy; Divine Bond; Aura of Resolve; Aura of Justice
archetypes.aonSummary: Some paladins focus their training to combat the shadows and use darkness to their advantage.

archetypes.name: Empyreal Knight
archetypes.replaces: Divine Grace; Mercy; Lay on Hands; Channel Positive Energy; Divine Bond; Holy Champion
archetypes.aonSummary: The empyreal knight dedicates her life to serving the celestial beings that guide mortals in their struggle toward the light.

archetypes.name: Faithful Wanderer
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Detect Evil; Aura of Good; Aura of Justice; Aura of Courage; Aura of Resolve; Aura of Faith; Aura of Righteousness; Smite Evil; Divine Bond; Holy Champion
archetypes.aonSummary: A faithful wanderer is self-sufficient and unobtrusive and learns to pick her battles carefully, lest her mission end abruptly in a blaze of glory

archetypes.name: Forest Preserver
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Aura of Courage; Divine Health; Channel Positive Energy; Aura of Resolve; Aura of Justice; Aura of Faith
archetypes.aonSummary: Forest preservers are sacred defenders of the woodlands and of the wild creatures and natural beauty within them.

archetypes.name: Forgefather's Seeker
archetypes.replaces: Deity; Detect Evil; Smite Evil; Aura of Justice; Aura of Faith; Holy Champion
archetypes.aonSummary: Torag sends his seekers to locate constructs that are used for evil or that become uncontrollable

archetypes.name: Ghost Hunter
archetypes.replaces: Smite Evil; 6th and 9th-level Mercies
archetypes.aonSummary: Ghost hunters devote their lives to eliminating malevolent spirits and putting them to rest.

archetypes.name: Gray Paladin
archetypes.replaces: Alignment Restriction; Code of Conduct; Aura of Good; Class Skills; Smite Evil; Divine Grace; Aura of Courage; Aura of Resolve; Aura of Rightousness; Divine Health; Channel Positive Energy; Aura of Justice
archetypes.aonSummary: Gray paladins have discovered that in a world of intrigue, a strict code of honor hinders their options

archetypes.name: Holy Guide
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; 3rd and 6th-level Mercies
archetypes.aonSummary: A holy guide believes that it’s his sacred calling to clear the roads of bandits between towns as well as to escort travelers to safety.

archetypes.name: Holy Gun
archetypes.replaces: Weapon/Armor Proficiency; Detect Evil; Smite Evil; Divine Bond
archetypes.aonSummary: Not all paladins are knights in shining armor. Holy guns roam the world searching for evil. And where they find it, they put it down.

archetypes.name: Holy Tactician
archetypes.replaces: Smite Evil; Divine Health; Divine Bond; Aura of Courage; Aura of Resolve; Aura of Justice; Holy Champion
archetypes.aonSummary: The holy tactician inspires her allies on the field of battle.

archetypes.name: Hospitaler
archetypes.replaces: Smite Evil; Channel Positive Energy; Aura of Justice
archetypes.aonSummary: Paladins are known for their charity and for tending to the sick. The hospitaler takes to this calling above all others, spending much of her time healing the poor, and giving aid and succor to those in need.

archetypes.name: Hunting Paladin
archetypes.replaces: Class Skills; Armor Proficiencies; Smite Evil; Detect Evil; Spells; Aura of Resolve
archetypes.aonSummary: Hunting paladins are tenacious trackers and stealthy stalkers in pursuit of evildoers.

archetypes.name: Invigorator
archetypes.replaces: Smite Evil; Aura of Justice; Holy Champion
